thread:
acme-infra: Hey team — our CI jobs started failing today with 401 invalid_api_key on every Redwood request after a key rotation. Example from a job:
```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\"}
```
We inject REDWOOD_API_KEY from Vault using GitLab CI variables (the helper we added last week). Any pointers?

emma-support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the exact value of the env var (redact the middle) or at least its shape/length? Also which method are you using to pull from Vault (gitlab-ci template, vault-agent, custom script)?

acme-infra: We're using GitLab CI with the new pipeline helper. Redacted value looks like: `{"data":{"api_key":"sk_live_abcd1234efgh5678"}}` — hmm that looks like a JSON envelope, maybe the helper returns the whole object?

nate-eng: That is likely the issue. Redwood expects the raw key string (e.g. `sk_live_...`), not a JSON object. If your Vault KVv2 returns an envelope you need to extract the field — e.g. `VAULT_SECRET=$(cat secret.json | jq -r .data.api_key)` or use the template path to the value instead of the whole secret. Passing the envelope will result in the service seeing `{"data":{...}}` as the token and rejecting it.

acme-infra: That makes sense. Old deploy script used a vault-agent template that wrote the key plain, but the new helper returns the whole secret payload. Quick fix in pipeline to `jq -r`ed the field and re-run.

maya-eng: One extra gotcha to check after you extract: leading/trailing whitespace or newline/quotes. You can verify with `printf %s \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | od -c` to be sure there are no invisible chars. Also keys have a prefix/length we validate — so if it still 401 after extraction check rotation status in Console.

emma-support: Great find — marking thread as resolved from our side but leaving notes: docs update for Vault/GitLab templates + add quick troubleshooting snippet. :memo:

acme-infra: Thanks everyone — fix applied, CI green again. Will reach out if anything else crops up.
